## Flagship Systems & Projects
- **InterviewIQ** (Live: https://ai-interviewer-eight-navy.vercel.app/ | Repo: https://github.com/Yash122005/AI_INTERVIEWER)
  - AI technical assessment platform with real-time biometric and browser integrity telemetry (multi-face detection, window blur tracking, clipboard interception) and automated candidate scoring dossiers.
  - Stack: React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, ImageKit, AI APIs.
- **HirePoint** (Live: https://hire-point-fs27.vercel.app/ | Repo: https://github.com/Yash122005/HirePoint)
  - Role-isolated talent marketplace with multi-step onboarding, Clerk authentication, and Supabase PostgreSQL with row-level security (RLS).
  - Stack: React, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Clerk, Tailwind CSS.
- **Interview Prep Planner** (Live: https://resume-analyser1-85v2.vercel.app/ | Repo: https://github.com/Yash122005/Interview-Prep-Planner)
  - GenAI resume analyzer and day-by-day roadmap engine using Google Gemini API with strict Zod schema enforcement for deterministic JSON outputs.
  - Stack: React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Gemini API, Zod, JWT.
- **Value Education Cell Platform — BIT Mesra** (Live: https://value-education-cell-bitm.vercel.app/ | Repo: https://github.com/Yash122005/Value-Education-Cell---BITM)
  - Official digital campus archive and event platform combining Next.js static site generation with choreographed GSAP scroll motion.
  - Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, GSAP.
- **Music Streaming REST Backend** (Docs: https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/46428929/2sBXwqqVsv | Repo: https://github.com/Yash122005/Spotify-backend-)
  - Complete backend API with role-protected endpoints, media metadata pipelines, and published Postman specifications.
  - Stack: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, REST API, Postman.
- **Real-Time FX Exchange Utility** (Live: https://currency-convertor-tau-livid.vercel.app/ | Repo: https://github.com/Yash122005/Currency-Convertor/tree/main/src)
  - High-precision live foreign-exchange rates calculator with custom React hooks and debounced input ergonomics.
  - Stack: React, JavaScript, REST API, CSS3.
